_read_me: Business rules for LeadDesk. Edit a value, restart the app (sudo systemctl restart leaddesk-api), then re-run the eval (python -m evals.run_eval --set all). The app refuses to start if a value is invalid. See docs/SOP.md.
_queue_owners_note: account_manager tickets go to the client's own account manager (data/clients.json).

time_saved._note: Assumptions, shown as such on the Metrics page: handling a ticket by hand (read, look up the lead, decide, write) vs reviewing a drafted one. Replace with timings from the support team.
